tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnal 'byor gsum gyi khrid yig bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor can dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po thob par 'dod pas rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po sbyor ba yan lag drug nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ spang bar bya ba tshe 'di don du gnyer ba'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba mi dge ba rgyu dang bcas pa rgyun bcad/ dge ba dang mi dge ba 'dres pa so nam dang longs spyod spel nas sbyin pa khe drags 'dod pas byed pa dang*/ lo 'dod kyis rang gzhan gyi rgyud la mi phan par chos ltar du bcos pa/ bstod smad dang*/ grags ma grags dang*/ dga' mi dga'/ phan mi phan/ bde sdug la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad kyang dor bar byas la nyams su blang ngo*// bsten par bya ba ni/ yang dag pa'i bla ma dang*/ gnas ri khrod dben pa dang*/ sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams dang ldan pas/ rdzas kyi dngos po rnams dkon mchog mchod cing sbyin par btang*/ tshangs par spyod pa'i tshul khrims rtag tu bsrung*/ gzhan gyis brnyas pa dang tsha grangs dang*/ gos la sogs pa'i rkyen thams cad kyis mi 'jigs pa'i bzod pa'i go cha bgo /nyams len la le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus bya/ bsam gtan brten pa'i rkyen dal ba gsum brten/ shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyu theg chen gyi mdo rgyud blta ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dri bar bya'o// de rnams ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro'o// khyad par du nye ba'i sngon du 'gro ba mun khang yid dang mthun pa byas la/ lus bsku mnye dang khrus te/ ngal dub dang drag shul spang*/ ngag long gtam rgyun bcad la grags stong du shes par bya/ yid rnam rtog gi bsam pa rgyun bcad la ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la gzhol bar bya ba ni/ thun mgo ru snga ma'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ lus dkyil dkrungs la rked pa bsrang*/ mgrin pa dgug lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/

lce ma so'i drung du bzhag mig sna rtse sor bzhir gtad la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du nyams su blang snyam du sems bskyed la/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga/ g.yon dril bu sku la bsten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi smad g.yogs can/ de'i sku la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa gsal bar bsgoms la zhe thag pa nas gsol ba gdab/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dag nas ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye zhing*/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba thob par byin gyis brlab du gsol/ zhes brjod/ skabs su yi ge brgya pa bzlas so// de ni sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi la gsum ste sku rdo rje rgyu so sor bsdud pas 'bras bu bsam gtan dang*/ gsung rdo rje rgyu srog rtsol las 'bras bu 'dzin pa dang*/ thugs rdo rje rgyu rjes dran las 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin te rnam pa gsum mo// dang po ni/ nyams su len pa'i tshe/ mtshan mo dang nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mtshan mo gseng med khyim du ni// shin du mnyam bzhag bsgrub pa pos// byed pa lnga la bcing pa gnyis// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas mun khang legs par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lus dkyil lam/ lhan skyes kyi bskyed rim cung zad bsgom/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas byed pa lnga ni lus kyi gnad yin pas rkang pa rdo rje dkyil dkrungs sam/ de ma shes na dkyil dkrungs bde bar bya ba dang*/ lag pa rdo rje'i khu tshur ram rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya lte 'og tu bya ste/ brla'i rtsa non par bya ba dang*/

sgal tshigs bsrangs pa dang*/ mgrin pa yid tsam bkug ste brang rus non pa tsam bya ba dang*/ ro stod dang dpung pa seng ge ltar bsgyings pa lnga'o// bcing pa gnyis ni/ steng bcing pa dang*/ 'og tu bcing pa ste/ dang po ni/ steng dbang po'i sgo lnga bcing pa so sor bsdud ces bya ba/ so so ni sgo lnga tha dad du gzung 'dzin skye ba yin la// de bsdus nas stong nyid mi rtog par 'jog pa ste/ mig rdo rje gtsug gtor zhes bya ba smin 'tshams su blta/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ so gnyis ma reg tsam du bzhag sna cung zad gnyer/ rna ba yang de'i shugs la gyen du 'gro bas sgo lnga gcig tu bsdus te/ rlung thams cad rang sor bsdus te bzhag /yid rnam par mi rtog par mdun gyi mun khang gi sna rtse'i thad so sor nyi shu tsam du gtad nas ci yang yid la mi bya bar bzhag go /der sems zin pa dang rtags rnams 'char zhing*/ rlung sems gyen du 'gro zhing stong zhing snang ba'i nyams 'byung ste/ 'di nan tan du bsgom mo// de nas gnyis pa ni/ gal te ro stod brgyangs nas na ba dang*/ khams 'tshub pa dang*/ gnyid med par gyur na 'og tu bcing ste/ steng gi lta stangs glod la/ 'og gi rtsa gsum drag du bsdam/ rkang pa'i sor mo dgug /lag pa'i phyag rgya glod la rig pa lto bar gtad pas bde nyams skye zhing*/ rtags snang zang zing nub par 'gyur ro// de ltar res 'jog tu bsgoms pas du ba dang*/ smig sgyu dang*/ me khyer dang*/ mar me la sogs rnam pa bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang du ma yid dang dbang po'i yul du 'gyur zhing*/ sems gnas pa dang*/ drod bde ba dang bcas pa skye'o// mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas nyin mo'i rnal 'byor na/ bla gab med pa'i gnas su nam mkha' dngas pa'i tshe/ lus gnad dang lta stangs snga ma la mig smin 'tshams sor bzhir bzhag la bsgom mo// snga dro nyi ma la rgyab bstan te kha nub phyogs su blta'o// phyi dro kha shar phyogs su blta'o// gal te stong gzugs ma mthong na/

nyi ma'i 'od zer mig gi rdzi ma la phog par byas la sgom mo yun ring du nyi ma la phyogs nas lta stangs byar mi rung ste/ mig rab rib du 'gyur du 'ong ngo*// de yang*/ chu 'dzin dang ni bral ba yi// nam mkha' dngas par gyur pa la// snga dro nyi ma rgyab phyogs ste// phyi dro yang ni de bzhin no// nyin phyed mig la gnod phyir spang*// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bsgoms pas/ me 'bar ba lta bu dang*/ glog dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i 'od lta bu dang*/ sgra gcan mun nag lta bu dang*/ thig le ste drug dang*/ gzhan yang 'ja' tshon dang*/ gzugs kyi rnam pa du ma dang bcas pa 'byung ste/ nyin rtags dang mtshan rtags kyi snga phyi'i nges pa ni med de/ rlung lnga dang phung po lnga'i rang bzhin zin pa las snang ba'o// de ltar yun ring du bsgom ste/ steng 'og bcing pa re mos kyis nyams dang sbyar la bya'o// rtags thams cad kyi mthar nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ thig le dang 'brel ba'i re ga nag po brtan g.yo snang ba'i tshad 'dzin pa chu zla lta bu mthong bar 'gyur ro// rnam pa kun ldan gyi lha dang*/ gzhan yang dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ thams cad mi rtag cing 'gyur ba dang bcas pa yin no// de rnams ni rtsa dag par byed pas so sor bsdud pa ste/ ji srid thig le'i nang du ni// ri mo nag po skra'i tshad// de mthong 'od gsal go 'phang ni// rnam 'byor pa yis mthong par 'gyur// sor sor bsdud pa snyoms zhugs pas// sngags rnams thams cad byin gyis brlob// ces gsungs so// de nas so sor bsdud kyi 'bras bu bsam gtan bya ba ni/ shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dang*// dga' dang bde ba mi g.yo ba// bsam gtan yan lag lnga brtan pas// mngon shes snga thob mi bdag kye// zhes pas dang po rtog pa ni/ sngar so sor bsdud la mnyam par 'jog pa'i gnad de nyid la/ khyad par du shes rab kyi thig le'i dbus su re ga nag po dus kyi rtsa'i rang bzhin snang ba nyid rang gi sems snang bar thag bcad la/

de dang mtshungs par yul gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya/ chos rnams snang ba dang*/ stong pa gnyis su med par brtags nas/ de nyid kyi rgyun dran pa/ gzung 'dzin zhen rtog gis ma slad par 'jogs pa ni dpyod pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pas de'i 'bras bu'i yan lag /dga' ba ni sems thog tu skyo ste/ ye shes kyi ngo bo snang stong gnyis med kyi rtags mthong bas yang dag pa'i gnas lugs la nges shes brtan pa dang bde ba ni lus thog du byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba rab 'bring tha ma skye ba'o// de la ngo bo'i yan lag ni rtse gcig tu 'jog pa yin pas de rnams rab tu brtan pa'i bar bsgom par bya'o// de la brten nas rims kyis rtog dpyod nub pa dang*/ dga' bde nub pa dang*/ dran rig g.yo ba dang*/ rlung rgyu ba nub pa rnams rims kyi shugs la 'byung ngo*// de rnams ni bsam gtan dngos gzhi'o// phyi nang gi dbye bas yan lag lnga yang bcur 'gyur ro// de nas yan lag mngon par shes pa lnga bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni bshad par brjod do// mdor na rtags rnams kyi mthar thug thig le'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi sku rab tu brtan pa dang*/ stong gsum la sogs pa sgrib pa med par gsal ba dang*/ stong pa'i sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya dang*/ yid kyi chos thams cad la byan tshud pa'i shes rab skyes nas rgyu 'bras zhib tu shes pa na/ so sor bsdud bsam gtan dang bcas pa brtan pa'i rtags yin no// sku rdo rje'i rim pa bsnyen pa'o// de na rnal 'byor gnyis pa srog rtsol dang de'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ ngo bo ni rlung g.yas g.yon nas 'byung ba ste/ de la dbye ba/ g.yas sa chu me rlung nam mkha' lnga bsdud rims dang*/ g.yon nam mkha' rlung me chu sa lnga bskyed rims dang bcu ste/ de yang rnam rtog dang 'gro ldog cig pas 'di las su rung bar bya ba gal che bas/

nyams su len pa'i tshe sngon du lus gnad snga ma lta bu la/ lta stangs ni sngar bas phab la sna'i rtse mor gtad pa'am thad kar bya'o// stong gzugs mthong ba sngon du song bas thog mar rlung mang du bus la rlung ro bsal/ de nas rlung rngub pa oṃ zla ba'i rang bzhin sku/ dbyung pa āḥnyi ma'i rang bzhin gsung*/ gnas pa hūṃ sgra gcan gyi rang bzhin thugs su shes pas dran pa rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni dang po'o// de nas skabs su 'dzub mos g.yas bkag te/ g.yon nas rngubs nas lte bar thun gcig bsdams ste/ yang g.yon bkag nas g.yas nas dbyung ste de ltar 'khor bar bya ba dang*/ yang na mgrin pa'i rtsa skabs su gtim pa ni rnam par mi rtog par 'jug par ste/ de ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i sngon 'gro yin no// de nas myur du rlung byang bar 'dod na 'khrul 'khor bya'o// de yang rked pa bskor ba dang*/ mgrin pa bskor ba dang*/ seng ge rnam grol lag pa dang*/ rkang pa sprug pa dang*/ tshigs thams cad bskor ba dang*/ 'phur ba dang*/ mnye ba dang*/ de rnams gang byed pa/ rlung dang bstun nas byed pa dang*/ sprug pa rnams ni phal cher rlung dbyung ba dang dus cig byed pa gal che'o// des lus thams cad byang zhing bde bar gyur nas/ dngos gzhi ni/ srog dang rtsol ba'i rlung dag rab tu drangs la lte ba'i dbus su gzhug /thur du sel ba'i rlung nyid drangs la de la bsnun nas cung zad gzhil bar rengs par byas la bar du rnam par brgyangs nas rnam par mi rtog par bzhag pas rlung thams cad las su rung zhing mchog gi rtsa la 'jug par byed do// de yang*/ dbugs dbyung bar ma mchog yin te/ bshang gci dang ni zla nyi yi// rtsa bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan// ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin dbugs// 'byung ba lnga yi ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas lnga yis byin brlabs la// srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad// ces byung ngo*// de ltar bum pa can bsgom pa'i tshad ni ci srid mgo mi na ba'i bar du bya ste/

de bas nang du dgag pa drags na tshangs bug 'bur bar 'gyur ste/ 'pho ba'i skyon du 'gyur ro// de bas na ran par byas la steng du skyon 'ong tshad na 'khrul 'khor dang rlung sbyor gyis thur la dbab pa'o// brtan pa'i tshad ni dus sbyor gcig dang*/ gsum dang*/ drug gi bar brtan na/ tha ma dang*/ 'bring dang*/ rab kyi tshad yin pas de nas 'dzin pa la sbyar bar bya'o// srog rtsol lo// de nas de'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa ni/ 'khor lo lnga la rlung 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dang 'ong ba dag par byed cing brtan pa ste/ rtag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni// rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'jug /ces byung pas/ gong gi srog rtsol du bshad pa bzhin lus gnad dang lta stangs 'dra ba la/ dang po thur sel bcing pa'i sbyor bas gsang bar bum pa can bya'o// de brtan nas lte bar steng gi zla nyi'i rlung dang 'og rlung gcig du bsdus te bum pa can bya'o// de brtan nas snying khar bum pa can bya'o// de brtan nas mgrin par bum pa can bya'o// mthar dpral bar rlung thad 'du bar 'gyur te de nas nang gi 'khor lo rnams la rlung rnams rtsol ba chung ngu 'jug cing las su rung bar 'gyur te/ de'i tshad ni zhag gcig gi dus sbyor bcu gnyis po nang du bkag kyang nad med par 'gyur ro// gong gi rlung sbyor bsgom dus rtsa ba'i rlung gi yul 'khor la bsnun pas/ phan pa dang gnod pa'i gegs mang du 'byung ste/ de bsal ba ni/ thur sel gyi skyon gyis lci zhing bying ba byung na steng du bcing zhing dbyung bar bya'o// me mnyam gyi skyon gyis tsha zhing brtse na kha nas sgra bcas su gzhug cing*/ ha'i sgras dbyung ngo*// gyen rgyu'i skyon gyis grang zhing 'dar ba dang*/ nang du grang na/ sna nas 'dren 'gugs drag tu bya zhing gtum mo la dmigs so// khyab byed kyi skyon gyis lus rengs pa dang skrangs pa byung na/ ha dang hūṃ gis kha sna nas drag tu dbyung zhing*/

mi bskyod pa'am chu yis lus bkrus la/ mar rnying ngam zhun gyis khyab par byug go /rtsol ba nyid kyi skyon gyis dbu ma la rengs nas khams 'dus dang rlung skyon byung na bde rlung sbrags ste dbyung ngo*// steng du rengs pa thur du dbab// 'og tu rengs pa gyen la 'phang*// sems la rengs na dbu ma'i sgor// bde bas bkang la dal gyis dbyung*// rdo rje dkyil dkrungs tsog pu dang*// sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs lus kyi gnad// bsdam dang dbyung dang gsang rlung gnad// rgya mtsho nam mkhar rlung bstim dang*// nyi zla me gsum gcig tu bya// sems kyi ting 'dzin gnad du 'dod// rgyud 'grel bla ma'i man ngag nas// byung ba phyin ci ma log pa// deng sang gzhan gyis shes pa med// de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor lo lnga dag cing 'gro 'ong bcu'i byed las kyis/ thig le la rang dbang du 'gyur ba ni 'dzin pa ste/ 'di brtan pa'i phan yon dpag tu med do// de ni gsung gi rdo rje nye bar bsnyen pa bsgrub pa dang 'brel pa'o// 'di nas rnal 'byor gsum pa rjes su dran pa dang de'i 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin ni/ rjes dran gyi gzhi gtum mo dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ de 'ching byed phyag rgya chen po dang*/ kun brtags ye shes dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang*/ las kyi phyag rgya'o// dang po ni/ lte bar gtum mo spar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan ma mig la sogs pa yang*// haṃ bsregs pa las zla rgyun bab// dam tshig sems dpa'i spyod yul can// zhes byung bas/ dang por lus gnad ni sems dpa'i dkyil dkrungs bya/ lta stangs ni rtsa gsum 'dus mdor te thur du blta ba'o// de nas gsang ba'i rtsa gsum 'dus par nyi ma'i steng du gtum mo ho'i rnam pa glog gi me dang mtshungs pa sran ma tsam me lta bu la dmigs ste rlung sbyor bya ste/ sku mthong nas ni nyin re bzhin// dus su srog gi rlung rnams ni// rnal 'byor thar pa 'dod pa yis// bum pa'i sbyor bas dgag par bya// zhes byung bas/

stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan dang ma bral bar gtum mo bsgoms nas rlung bar du bum pa can byas pas bde ba chen po 'bab par 'gyur ro// de nas yang gtum mo'i mes 'khor lo thams cad du khyab pa la dmigs nas bsgom mo// de brtan nas haṃ las thig le dkar po'i rgyun byung ste/ me dang 'dres pas dkar la dmar bas 'khor lo rnams rims kyis gang ba la sems bzung pas/ yas 'bab pa'i dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral dang*/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba 'byung ste/ 'di'i dus su rlung mas 'then phul byas pa ni dbab par 'gyur la/ bar rengs par bya ba ni brtan par 'gyur ro// steng ni ma yin no// des phung po lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ khams lnga yi yum dang*/ mig la sogs pa'i skye mched bcu gnyis kyi sems dpa' rnams bde bar ro gcig du byed do// de nyid la bde ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ snang ba'i stong gzugs ro mnyam par 'gyur bas/ 'khor lo lnga'i dbus kyi bha gar/ byang chub kyi sems ling ga bzhag pa ni/ rjes dran gyi rgyu yin la/ yul yul can gnyis kyi gzungs 'dzin dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sangs rgyas kyi sprin spros pas gzhan la phan pa dang*/ rang gi nyon mongs spangs shing 'dod sems spangs nas/ 'dod sems dang bsam gtan rnam rtog kun snang stong ro gcig tu byed pa sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi ngo bo bsgom pa'o// dbye ba ni rgyas bshad du 'byung ngo*// de yang*/ sems ni phyag rgyar rab tu zhugs// 'chog gi bde bar son pa'o// zhes so// de ltar bsgoms pas khams mi 'gyur nas gzung 'dzin thams cad bcad na/ de ni rab phyag rgya chen pos 'ching ba zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gal te des 'ching bar ma nus na kun btags ye shes kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bcing pa ni/ rgyud las/ pad ma rdo rje'i sgra nyid dam// rang lag bde ba'i don du ste// sa bon ma lhung dga' ba ni// rnal 'byor can gyi rnal 'byor ro// zhes byung pas/

sna tshogs yum mam/ phag mo lta bu 'am/ sems kyi btags pa'i phyag rgya gang yang rung ste/ yid kyis bde ba 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur pa bsgom pa dbab pa'o// de nas mi 'dzag par yun ring du brtan par byas la snang stong gi rang bzhin ro mnyam par bsgom par byas nas bzlog pa dang lus la khyab par bya'o// de nyid kyis khams 'gyur med du byed pa ni 'bring yin no// gsum pa gzhan lus kyi bcing pa ni/ gang zag tha ma 'ga' zhig snga ma gnyis kyis 'ching bar ma nus na/ sngags skyes dang*/ rigs dang*/ zhing skyes/ rgyas gdab ma log pa legs par sbyangs la bsten par bya'o// de nyid rtsa rgyud las/ bcu drug lo lon rigs rnams la// gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan// dang po legs par sbyangs byas la// slob mas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya// oṃ āḥ hūṃ ho bzhi po ni// dpral ba la sogs rnams su dgod// swa hās gsang ba gtsug gtor du// de nas pad ma rnam par sbyang*// a yig pad ma 'dab ma brgyad// hūṃ yig rang gi rdo rje ni// rtse mo lnga par bsgom par bya// hūṃ phaṭa byas la de yang ni// rnal 'byor gho ku rdor 'dzin bskyod// bha gar ling ga rab bzhag la/ byang chub sems ni btang mi bya// khams gsum ma lus pa ru ni// sangs rgyas sku ru bsgom par bya// zhes byung ba ltar bsgoms la// dbab pa dang*/ bzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ khyab par bya bas 'dzag pa med par bya'o// de yang dngul chu 'ching ba bzhin du khams bcings pas/ dus sbyor drug 'ching nus na 'dze la sogs pa 'joms so// de gnyis 'gyur du bcings pas ni phyag rgya chen po bde blag du 'grub pa'o// zhes byung ngo*// bum pa can dang btsan thabs dang*// mi rtog bzung ba gsum du 'dod// hūṃ hūṃ ha ha phaṭa bcas pas// ri bo 'degs dang gling bzhi bcud// gyad stobs zhes bya gyen du 'gro// rnam grol seng ge'i sprug stangs kyis// khyab byed gnad kyi man ngag yin// de ltar 'dod khams las kyi phyag rgya dang*// gzugs khams yid skyes bsam gtan dang bcas pa dang*/

gzugs med sor bsdud dang bcas pas ro mnyam par byas nas/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan par/ ma chags pa dang*/ 'dzag pa med pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la bzod pa dang*/ rgyun ma chad pa dang*/ rtse cig pa dang*/ thams cad sems su shes pa dang*/ rtsa rlung bcing pa dang*/ smon pa dang bral ba dang*/ sems la dbang bsgyur ba dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi 'od zer ba spu thams cad nas 'phro bas yul dang lus 'od gsal du gyur pa ni/ rim pa bzhin du pha rol du phyin pa bcu'i nang gi rjes dran du 'gyur ro// de yang*/ ji srid du ni 'khor bzhin ma// rang gi lus la yongs bskor ba// 'od zer 'khor lo mthong 'gyur te// sngon song sku la rang gis yin// de ni zla drug reg spangs bde// chu nyi lta bur rab snang ba// dri ma med pa sna tshogs mdog /rnam pa kun du rang gi sems// zhes bya'o// de'i 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gis 'dzin pa la brten nas rjes dran de ltar sngon du byas pas nyon mongs pa'i bsgrib pa/ dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa mthong bas bcom nas/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag med cing gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dag pa'i skad cig de nyid la/ nang du 'dzin pa la brten nas las kyi rlung rnam rtog dang gnad gcig pa brgya phrag bco brgyad 'gags par gyur cing mas brtan pa'i thig le nor bu'i rtser 'gags na sla ba 'dzag pa yang med pa na/ ma rig pa 'gags pas mthong lam gyi ting nge 'dzin ji snyed pa 'thob bo// de nas 'khor lo drug la rlung brgya phrag bcwo brgyad pa re dang/ thig le brtan pa dang bcas pa zhugs pa dang*/ dbang byed pa gnyis gnyis kyi dbye bas bcu gnyis su 'gyur bas/ rlung nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya dang bcas pa'i rtog pa zad pa dang*/ dga' ba bcu drug dang*/ snying rje bcu drug dang*/ stong pa nyid bcu drug dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag pas sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi sa bcu dang*/

'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa ste bcu gnyis dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ gzungs dang*/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i yon tan gyis rnam par phye ba'i ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa thob cing*/ mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// de yang*/ rang gi sems nyid bde ba nyid// ting 'dzin bde chen rnal 'byor la// zhes gsungs pa ni ngo bo yin la/ spyan lnga mngon shes drug 'byung ste// chu srin pa sogs khyim rnams su// ma rig la sogs lugs bzlog pas// sa ni bcu gnyis thob 'gyur te// rtog pa med pa'i chos can las// skad cig gcig la mngon sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mtshan brjod las kyang/ pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste// pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas// pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste// pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul// mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste// zhes 'dzin pas thob pa dang*/ rjes dran gyis gnas pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis dag par gsungs shing*/ rgyud nas yan lag drug gi 'bras bu'i skabs nas/ rtag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni// bdud dang nyon mongs rab 'joms shing*// stobs bcu pa ni 'jug par 'gyur// rjes su dran pa dag gyur na// ye shes gzugs brnyan dag las ni// dri med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor ro// de las dag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// lo gsum zla phyed gsum gyis ni// ye shes sku nyid 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so// mdor bsdus na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ni rtse gcig gis dbang byed pa'o// thabs ni zhi lhag gis rnam par mi rtog pa nyid du sbyong ba'o// rnam dbye ni tshad med de/ rnam rtog rtsal sbyong du kho bos bshad pa ltar rnam rtog ji snyed pa ting nge 'dzin yang de tsam mo// bsdud byed ni mnyam rjes gnyis su 'du'o// gzhom bya ni sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'o// 'bras bu thob bya ni sku bzhi lhun grub ste/

'di rnams bshad pa ni rnam par phye ba las rgyas par bshad pas 'dir ma bshad do// bden pa bzhi dang de nyid brgyad// bcu gnyis don dang bcu drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pas// rnam pa sangs rgyas kun rig nas// skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// ting 'dzin mthar phyin 'bras bu'o// sbyor ba yan lag drug las/ rnal 'byor gsum pa thugs rdo rje dang*/ ye shes kyi rim pa nyams su blang pa'i thabs lam khrid kyi rim pa'o// bla na med pa'i rgyud kun gyi// rdzogs rims mthar thug rnal 'byor gsum// 'jam dbyangs grags pas bsdus pa las// nyams su blang tshul khrid 'di ni// rgyud 'grel bla ma'i byin brlabs las// rang byung rdo rjes shes nas bris// 'gro kun bla med sku thob shog /snod min rnams la bka' rgyas bsang*// rgya rgya/ 'di 'dra'i dam chos rgyal khams su// 'gyog byed rlung gi rta pho la// bcibs nas phyogs med btsal gyur kyang*// nga rang byung rgyud yin su la med// 'di ni ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad/// /
